capabilities: Run configured Python scripts from sidebar buttons
Pass the editor selection to scripts and replace it with the output
Detect the Python interpreter automatically (python3, python, py)
Organize script buttons with separators and group labels
Show success or error notices after each script run
extras: Desktop only; the mobile app does not support launching Python as a child process. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to launch local Python scripts from the UI, so running scripts on vault notes means switching to a terminal.
summary: Sidebar panel with one button per configured Python script that runs the script as a child process and reports status feedback.
